[[Elementalist Deldrimor armor]] is the collective name used to refer to the standalone armor pieces (i.e. not a set) crafted for elementalists by [[Gobrech Stonefoot]] in [[Central Transfer Chamber]]. It is also sometimes referred to as Dwarven armor.

It is made up of the following pieces:
*[[Elementalist Thaumaturgic Robes|Thaumaturgic Robes]]
*[[Elementalist Yeoryios Gloves|Yeoryios Gloves]]
*[[Elementalist Exquisite Leggings|Exquisite Leggings]]
*[[Elementalist Majestic Shoes|Majestic Shoes]]

The total cost for all pieces would be 350{{cloth}}, 35{{silk}} and 40{{plat}}
